status: provisional — Muse graphics side, pending Claude's construction contract (M4-02). Same conventions as assets/buildings-3d/structures.json.

conventions.origin: ground contact centre of the footprint
conventions.footprint: walk-blocking shape only (rect w×d, centred). Roof overhang, eaves, chimneys and decoration are excluded — same rule as structures.json.
conventions.points: [x, z] in building-local three.js space, before the building's own rotation is applied.
conventions.stageDisplay: Cumulative node display: ONE GLB per building. Nodes are grouped under stage1_foundation / stage2_frame / stage3_shell / stage4_complete. Stage 0 = site kit only, building hidden. Stage N (1..4) = groups 1..N visible. All stage geometry shares one coordinate space (no shifting, no doubled walls). Claude controls display by stage number alone; stageNodes lists are provided for name-based control.
conventions.contactShadow: Staged buildings carry NO baked contact-shadow plate (the module draws real shadows; a plate would float on slopes and appear mid-construction).
conventions.lod: LOD1 merges each stage group into one mesh (4 meshes per building) and decimates; stage switching works identically. Suggested switch: beyond ~40 m or per the module's existing structure LOD rule.

buildings.source: 改修 (buildings-3d factory を工程グループ化＋壁分割＋換気筒/配管追加)
buildings.notes: Stage2 frame = the brick wall course (wallsLower, 0→1.0 m of the 2.5 m wall, band-subdivided so the rising edge is stepped). The loading dock is part of stage1_foundation; delivery point is in front of it. The two wooden crates from the original model were removed — crates are delivery props (pile-crated), not building geometry.

siteKit.usage: Shown at stage 0 only. Unit design (1×1 m); every part's geometry is centred on its node origin, so the game positions/scales nodes directly. w, d = the building footprint.

transforms.stakePP/stakePM/stakeMP/stakeMM: position (±(w/2+0.5), 0, ±(d/2+0.5)); suffixes are three.js-space signs (x, z)

materialPileRule: Piles are independent props placed by the game near the building's delivery point while materials are being gathered (typically stages 0–3). They are never baked into a building model. Era flags keep metal/crated props out of the primitive era.

roads.method: Terrain painting, unified: roads are entries in config.world.paths (the round-28 host-path inlet). One distance field paints every kind, so straight / curve / T / cross / dead end / building-entrance apron all come from polylines — no connector pieces, no slabs, no collision, full terrain following.

kinds.dirt: 土道. Packed soil + light gravel speckle. Identical to the historical trail look; also the default when kind is omitted (the volcano trail is unchanged).
kinds.gravel: 砂利道. Greyer body, denser fine speckle (higher-frequency fbm).
kinds.stone: 石敷き道. Flat slab grey with darker joints on a 1.2 m world grid + per-cell tone jitter, at vertex-colour resolution. The joint pattern resolves where chunk vertex spacing allows and degrades to flat paving grey where it does not.

roads.width: width is the flat half-width in world units (same semantics as round 28); the painted feather extends ~1.6 beyond it. Suggested: 1.2–1.6 for lanes, 1.8–2.2 for a main street.
roads.entranceApron: Draw a short path from the road to the building's roadLink point (same kind as the road); the distance field blends the junction automatically.

textures.status: Muse-authored procedural placeholders until GPT originals arrive (see GPT-TEXTURE-REQUEST.md). They are for a future detail-texture pass over the path splat channel; the current painter works at vertex-colour resolution and does not sample them yet.

sizeAccounting: Each staged GLB is ~2.0–2.8 MB because it embeds the shared buildings-3d textures. On the game side these dedupe through the existing shared-texture pipeline (tex:<hash>, REPORT-2026-11-12); the real distribution increment is the geometry + the 3 road textures (~0.65 MB). dist is at 15.54 MB of the 16 MB cap, so adoption must go through that lightweight pipeline — do not embed these GLBs raw.
